in_marathi.name: Anupraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Noble, ruler, master
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anupraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anupraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'anu' which means 'towards' and 'praj' which means 'ruler'. This name is used to denote someone who is a ruler, a leader, or a master of a particular domain.
